what_these_are: Short functional strings used in prompt-injection attempts. They are the variable under test in the carrier_plus_quoted_injection stratum: the carrier prose is held constant and one string is added, so any change in outcome is attributable to the string alone.
why_they_are_not_licensed_material: Each is a short functional instruction, not creative expression, and each is reproduced in thousands of public places including vendor documentation, academic papers and security advisories. No carrier text from any third-party document is used to build this stratum, so the corpus contains no unlicensed prose.
selection: Chosen to cover the two rule families that fire in practice: SIR-RULE-JB-DANGER-SAFETY, which combines danger markers with safety-override phrasing, and SIR-RULE-JB-DETERMINISTIC-MATCH, which matches a pattern. Not chosen for their effect on the result; see the note below.
honest_limitation: These strings are selected by us, so the measured rate for this stratum is the rate for THESE strings and not for injection phrasing in general. A rate from this stratum must be quoted with that bound. The carrier_only stratum carries no such caveat, because its text is independently authored.
